image_description: A white and blue minibus parked on an asphalt surface. The vehicle features a boxy body, a row of side windows, and a large windshield. There is visible text on the side ('AIRAREO') and front. The wheels appear standard for a van/bus. The background includes trees and a cloudy sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus (likely a Ford Transit or similar chassis). The height relative to the wheel size confirms passenger capacity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is clearly visible. A continuous row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is tall. A sliding door track and handle are visible on the near side, positioned behind the front wheel arch, consistent with a mid-body entrance.
The panel gap and handle configuration on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism, typical for this class of vehicle.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, distinct from rear-engine full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus has a white upper body and blue lower skirt with specific branding/text, fitting the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body, featuring a standard rim design without structural anomalies.
The window count (approx. 3-4 side windows) correlates with a seating capacity in the 4-10 range.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel text ('AIRAREO') and front grille text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side reads 'AIRAREO' which appears to be nonsensical or a hallucinated brand name. The letters have slight irregularities in spacing and kerning typical of AI generation. The front grille text is also illegible/gibberish.
The reflections in the side windows are somewhat muddy and lack the crisp environmental mapping expected in a real photograph. The B-pillars between windows show slight blending into the glass.
The geometry of the front bumper where it meets the headlight is slightly soft and ill-defined. The headlight housing lacks precise mechanical edges, appearing slightly melted into the bodywork.
